title: xte W7 (gate run): run a cloud epic on the deployed factory, restart the orchestrator mid-run, and record the provider per attempt
body: Parent xte; blocked by W1-W6. This is the named tick that PERFORMS xte's gate: one sandbox per tick, pi on GLM per attempt in the trace, no claude process in the container, and a restart that adopts the running sandbox via the real cloudflaresandbox.Executor rather than dispatching a rival (subsumes dccd84cf). It touches a live system, so it needs the operator's go-ahead. It is also mn7's precondition.
